content.comment_body: Is it possible to connect a low power 24VDC load to the output relays of [product_name] ([article_no])?

What do you consider as low power? Is it an inductive or resistive load? Will it be switched continuously or infrequently? According to the specifications: Relay outputs switching capacity — with inductive load: max. 3A — with resistive load: max. 10A There should be no issues if the load draws less than 1A.
Hello, The [product_name] manual indicates: > 100mA at 12V DC.
